description:
Rank wheat lines for a trait across T3/Wheat trials (US public breeding programmes, about 9,000 trials):
for each trial the line mean is compared with that trial's mean (percent of trial mean), then averaged over the
trials a line was in. trait: words matched to T3 variable names (e.g. 'grain yield', 'plant height', 'heading',
'test weight', 'stripe rust'); variable: one exact variable name from the 'variables' list returned; filters:
year_from/year_to, location and program (text in the T3 location / breeding programme, e.g. 'Kansas', 'Cornell');
min_trials: lines seen in fewer trials are left out; direction 'high' or 'low'. Gives n trials, mean percent of
trial mean, raw mean and example trials. Relative-to-trial ranking is a simple screen, not a mixed-model BLUP:
lines in few or weak trials can rank high by chance, so give n trials and say so.
name: t3_trait_lines
